message:
fix(registry): make shadcn CLI install succeed for all 25 components

Three independent bugs caused `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add` to fail or
produce broken installs:

1. `registryDependencies` emitted bare names like `"text-shimmer"`, which
   shadcn CLI resolves against the default `ui.shadcn.com` registry —
   breaking install for 14 composite components. Emit absolute URLs.

2. `IMPORT_REGEX` excluded `import type` / `export type`, so type-only
   files like `types.ts`, `types/timeline.ts`, and `icons/source-icons.ts`
   were never bundled. Post-install `tsc` failed with TS2307 even when all
   items were installed. Walk type-only imports into the graph too.

3. None of the items shipped `agent-ui.css`, where the `--an-*` CSS
   variables and Tailwind v4 `@theme inline` color tokens live. Installs
   "succeeded" visually broken — no `bg-an-background`, `text-an-foreground`,
   etc. Ship the stylesheet with every item and auto-inject the `@import`
   into the consumer's `globals.css` via the top-level `css` field.

Verified end-to-end in a fresh Next.js 16 + Tailwind v4 sandbox: all 25
components install cleanly, `tsc --noEmit` passes, and the dev build
generates the expected `an-*` utility classes.

Add mobile fullscreen search and update layout

Introduce MobileSearchContent for a fullscreen mobile search experience and swap the previous modal content to use it (grouped results, suggestions, and cancel button). Tweak sidebar mobile positioning (top-12 + mt-2). Refactor SiteLayout: remove theme toggle usage, add SIDEBAR_SECTIONS and componentIdFromName imports, implement formatComponentLabel and getPageTitle to derive the mobile header title, and add scrollToTop behavior when tapping the title. Rework mobile header (hamburger | title | search) and adjust collapsed-sidebar header to show a menu button instead of theme/GitHub controls; simplify sidebar open/close handling.

fix(llms-full): narrow ComponentExampleBlock first for type safety

ComponentTextBlock.type is "code" | "usage", so excluding both literals
didn't narrow the union to ComponentExampleBlock. Check the "example"
literal first — TS narrows cleanly to ComponentExampleBlock and the
fall-through handles the remaining ComponentTextBlock variants.

Fixes the production build failure on Vercel.

  README) ready to publish to skills.sh or drop into ~/.claude/skills/.

  land under components/agent-elements/<name>.tsx instead of
  components/agent-elements/components/<name>.tsx. Build script now
  rewrites relative imports to keep them valid after the move.
- Regenerate all 25 registry items and update docs / COMPONENT_IMPORT_PATH
  to match.

Housekeeping:

- Delete /docs/test-agent, update search suggestions.
- Point every GitHub link to 21st-dev/agent-elements after the rename.
